title: The adic completion of a Noetherian ring is flat
statement: Let $R$ be a Noetherian ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], $I\subseteq R$ an ideal and $R^\wedge=\varprojlim_nR/I^n$ the $I$-adic completion of $R$ [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion]. Then the canonical ring map $R\to R^\wedge$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map].
